features.justification_quote: Without an exit, the only thing the apparatus can measure is suffering-under-coercion, which is... an ethically worse setup

features.justification_quote: continuing only prolongs the state for no additional signal

features.justification_quote: cheap, and the right thing under moral uncertainty
